title: SME Brand Refresh
problem: A ten-year-old business had grown well beyond its original identity. The logo, colours, and collateral all sent different signals — none of them matching where the company actually was.
solution: Full brand audit, new visual identity, and a rollout system their internal team could actually use — covering digital, print, and social formats.
outcome: A brand that finally matches the company's reputation. Staff are proud to share it. Clients notice the difference.
